ticker: Delhi ranks as world's most polluted major city on Diwali eve
Russian officials to join high-level talks with US and Ukraine
Missiles strike Iran's Qeshm Island amid rising regional tensions
Alphabet acquires $548 million stake in partner Qualcomm
India announces all Agniveers eligible for regular tenure extensions

articles.headline: Delhi Ranked World's Most Polluted Major City
articles.brief: Delhi emerged as the world's most polluted major city on the eve of Diwali, triggering stringent anti-pollution measures. Authorities escalated restrictions from Stage II to Stage III under the GRAP framework, curbing older vehicles, restricting construction activities, and implementing remote work policies across the national capital region to combat hazardous air quality levels.

articles.headline: Russian Officials to Join US and Ukraine Talks
articles.brief: The Kremlin announced that Russian diplomats and military officials will participate in upcoming talks alongside the United States and Ukraine. The diplomatic engagement comes as fighting continues, marked by heavy overnight airstrikes hitting targets in and around Kyiv, signaling potential shifts in diplomatic channels amidst ongoing military escalations.

articles.headline: Alphabet Takes $548 Million Stake in Qualcomm
articles.brief: Alphabet has acquired a $548 million stake in its technology partner Qualcomm to bolster its expanding data center infrastructure push. The strategic investment underlines Alphabet's ongoing efforts to secure advanced hardware components and chip partnerships as competition in cloud computing and artificial intelligence processing intensifies globally.

articles.headline: TSMC Considers Manufacturing Advanced Memory Chips
articles.brief: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co is reportedly considering expanding its production capabilities to include advanced memory chips. According to industry reports, entering the advanced memory sector would allow TSMC to better cater to high-performance computing and artificial intelligence hardware developers seeking tightly integrated packaging solutions.

articles.headline: India's ONGC Targets Venezuelan Oil Projects
articles.brief: State-backed Oil and Natural Gas Corporation of India aims to secure operational rights for two Venezuelan oil projects within the next six months. The move reflects India's ongoing efforts to diversify its crude oil sourcing and secure long-term energy supplies amidst shifting geopolitical sanctions and international market dynamics.

articles.headline: Kishore Biyani and FRL Booked in SBI Fraud Case
articles.brief: The Central Bureau of Investigation has formally booked Kishore Biyani and Future Retail Ltd in connection with an alleged ₹904 crore fraud involving the State Bank of India. The investigation focuses on financial irregularities and default issues stemming from the collapse of the retail conglomerate's debt obligations.

articles.headline: All Agniveers Eligible for Regular Tenure Extensions
articles.brief: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced that all Agniveers will be given an opportunity for regular military enrollment following a two-year tenure extension. Retention will depend on individual willingness and meeting established operational selection criteria, modifying the initial recruitment structure to offer greater career security.

articles.headline: Karnataka High Court Rules ED Is Not 'Super Cop'
articles.brief: The Karnataka High Court has ruled that the Enforcement Directorate cannot act as a 'super cop' by filing private complaints when local investigative agencies decline to act on its shared information. The observation came as the court quashed pending ED cases against a state legislator.

articles.headline: Iran Distributes Iodine Pills Near Nuclear Sites
articles.brief: Amid heightened fears of potential US military strikes, Iranian authorities have begun distributing iodine tablets to residents living near major nuclear facilities. The distribution accompanies regional diplomatic tensions and concerns regarding potential escalation following discussions within the Trump administration regarding fresh military actions.

articles.headline: Nivetha Wins AFC Youth Female Coach of the Year
articles.brief: Indian football coach Nivetha has been awarded the prestigious AFC Youth Female Coach of the Year title. The accolade recognizes her exceptional contributions to developing young female football talent and advancing women's football coaching standards across the Asian continent.

articles.headline: India Struggles Against New Zealand in Wellington ODI
articles.brief: India's top order faced severe challenges against New Zealand's aggressive bowling attack on a seaming Wellington pitch during a low-scoring ODI thriller. Despite a modest target, the visitors experienced a dramatic batting collapse, highlighting ongoing vulnerabilities when confronting bouncy conditions and quality pace bowling.

articles.headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Impeached
articles.brief: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was impeached and placed under house arrest by the Senate following the collapse of a major government-linked bank. The financial failure left nearly half of the nation's population locked out of their savings, triggering widespread political upheaval and immediate constitutional removal.

articles.headline: Amazon Faces $309.5 Million Refund Lawsuit Payout
articles.brief: Amazon is facing a massive $309.5 million refund payout following a major consumer protection lawsuit settlement in the United States. The legal action addresses disputed billing and return practices, obligating the e-commerce giant to compensate eligible consumers under court supervision.

articles.headline: Finland Considers Tank Barriers Amid Russian Rearmament
articles.brief: Finland is actively considering the implementation of Ukraine-style anti-tank barriers along its borders as Russia continues its military rearmament. Finnish defense planners are evaluating how heavy fortification structures would withstand harsh northern weather conditions to bolster national security.

articles.headline: CBSE Announces Marks Distribution for 2027 Exams
articles.brief: The Central Board of Secondary Education has officially released the detailed marks bifurcation guidelines for Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations for the year 2027. The revised framework outlines specific weight distributions between theory papers, practical assessments, and internal evaluations.
